Sun & Moon series · UPR

Ultra Prism

Released February 2, 2018 · 178 cards

Expanded

Ultra Prism is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the Sun & Moon series, released in English on February 2, 2018. Its main set has 156 cards, plus 22 secret rares numbered beyond the set (178 in total). It includes 137 Pokémon, 36 Trainer and 5 Energy cards, and is legal in the Expanded format (rotated out of Standard).

Illustrators

47 illustrators worked on Ultra Prism. Most cards: 5ban Graphics (29), Ken Sugimori (11), Toyste Beach (10), kawayoo (7), Shin Nagasawa (7), Masakazu Fukuda (5), nagimiso (5), Anesaki Dynamic (4).
